events.title: Rheingauer Weinwoche 2026
events.description: The 'longest wine bar in the world' takes over Wiesbaden's old town around Schloßplatz, Marktkirche and Dern'sches Gelände. Roughly 100 stands pour close to 1,000 Rheingau wines and sparkling wines, accompanied by live music and regional food from 14 to 23 August.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival – Konzerte
events.description: Europe's largest privately financed music festival runs its summer season of 158 concerts at 26 venues across the Rheingau and Wiesbaden until 5 September. Programme ranges from orchestral evenings at Kloster Eberbach's Basilica to chamber and open-air concerts at Schloss Vollrads, Schloss Johannisberg and the Kurhaus.

events.title: Rüdesheimer Weinfest 'Summer of Riesling'
events.description: Over 200 wines from 13 Rheingau wineries are poured on the historic Marktplatz of Rüdesheim (13-17 August). The renowned 'Summer of Riesling' festival features live bands, a Rheinischer Abend and festive wine-festival flair in the old town at the foot of the vineyards.

events.title: RMF – Wein- und Konzertabend Schloss Vollrads
events.description: Wine culture meets classical music at the baroque Schloss Vollrads in the Rheingau. An open-air summer concert with Rheingau Riesling served in the famous castle courtyard.

events.title: Hallgartener Hoffest
events.description: The Hallgarten winery cooperative (Oestrich-Winkel) throws a relaxed open-air Hoffest amid the vineyards with Rhine views, live music and food from 'Einfach Mel'. Summer feeling right in the middle of the Rheingau slopes.

events.title: Johannes Oerding – Sommer Open Air
events.description: German singer-songwriter Johannes Oerding performs an open-air concert on the Karlswiese in Kassel as part of his 2026 summer tour. A large crowd-pleasing evening of German pop-rock anthems.

events.title: Stadtfest Gießen
events.description: One of Mittelhessen's largest city festivals fills Gießen's city centre (14-16 August) with several open-air stages of live music, sports demonstrations, club stands, kid's programme and gastronomy. Final day on 16 August.

events.title: European Elvis Festival Bad Nauheim
events.description: Europe's largest Elvis Presley fan festival is staged in the spa town where Elvis was stationed with the US Army (14-17 August). Tribute acts, concerts, Elvis flea market and memorabilia throughout the town.

events.title: Schlosswingert-Weinfest Limburg
events.description: Limburg's revamped Schlossgarten opens officially on 15 August, launching the Schlosswingert-Weinfest with wine, music and the new garden as a highlight of the old town. Weekend of tasting and discovery in the shadow of the cathedral.

events.title: feel Collins – Amphitheater Hanau
events.description: The tribute show 'feel Collins' (music of Phil Collins & Genesis) performs at the Amphitheater Hanau on the evening of 16 August. A nostalgic open-air concert of classic rock and pop hits.

events.title: Kaiserfest Fritzlar – Mittelaltermarkt
events.description: The medieval Kaiserfest Frideslar (14-16 August) transforms Fritzlar's old town into the historical city of Frideslar with jugglers, craftsmen, taverns and a camp group. Thousands of visitors enjoy the free-open historic market at the foot of the great cathedral.

events.title: Wiesbaden Kurhaus – Konzertabend
events.description: An evening classical concert programme at the grand Kurhaus Wiesbaden as part of the Rheingau Musik Festival / Meisterkonzerte season. World-class soloists and orchestras perform in the opulent Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal.

events.title: Wochenmarkt Wiesbaden
events.description: The historic Wiesbaden weekly market at the Dern'sches Gelände runs every Wednesday and Saturday with regional produce, flowers, cheese and street food. A vibrant open-air shopping morning in the heart of the spa city.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – James Arthur
events.description: British singer-songwriter James Arthur headlines an open-air concert at the stunning Kloster Schiffenberg venue as part of the Gießener Kultursommer (19-31 August). His hit-driven set of pop-soul anthems fills the Mittelhessen hills.

events.title: A Night @ The Museum – RMF
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival presents a late-night concert inside the striking Museum Reinhard Ernst in Wiesbaden. An atmospheric programme of contemporary and classical music framed by modern art architecture.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – Donots & H-Blockx
events.description: German rock icons DONOTS and H-BLOCKX share one stage at the Gießener Kultursommer open-air venue at Kloster Schiffenberg on 21 August. A double bill of live punk-rock energy under the open sky.

events.title: Open-Air-Kino Marburg – Sommerkino
events.description: Marburg's summer open-air cinema at the Schlossparkbühne runs its 30th season until 5 September, screening current films on one of Germany's largest outdoor screens. Bring a blanket for a magical evening under the stars beside the castle.

events.title: Wochenmarkt Darmstadt
events.description: Darmstadt's weekly market spreads across the Marktplatz in the city centre every Wednesday, Friday and Saturday from 08:00. Regional fruit, vegetables, baked goods and delicacies from the Odenwald and Rhein-Main.

events.title: XXL Flohmarkt Kassel
events.description: The XXL flea market at Kassel's Messehallen and surrounding grounds (Hansen-Märkte) offers over a thousand metres of stalls with second-hand goods, vintage and collectibles. A popular Saturday treasure hunt in Nordhessen.

events.title: RMF – Fahrende Musiker / Weingüter
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival's popular free daytime events take 'wandering musicians' through the wine villages and estates of the Rheingau. Visitors combine wine tasting with spontaneous classical street performances in the romantic old towns.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – Howard Carpendale
events.description: Schlager legend Howard Carpendale brings his evergreen hits to the Gießener Kultursommer at Kloster Schiffenberg. A warm summer evening of German pop classics under the open sky.

events.title: KunstHandwerk Odenwald – Markt Michelstadt
events.description: Odenwald artisans present woodwork, glass, textiles and more in Michelstadt's Stadtgarten in the historic half-timbered town. A quality handicraft market with demonstrations against the backdrop of the Odenwald hills (23-24 August).

events.title: Werra-Meißner Kultursommer – Konzerte
events.description: The Werra-Meißner-Kreis runs its summer culture series with open-air concerts and readings across the region around Eschwege, Witzenhausen and Bad Sooden-Allendorf into late summer. Local ensembles, wine and regional food.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – Nena
events.description: German pop icon Nena performs at the Gießener Kultursommer open-air stage at Kloster Schiffenberg. A sing-along evening of '99 Luftballons' and her unmistakable blend of rock and pop classics.

events.title: MS Wissenschaft – Ausstellungsschiff
events.description: The floating science centre MS Wissenschaft docks in Rüsselsheim's harbour on 24 August with a hands-on exhibition aboard. Interactive exhibits on science and technology for curious visitors of all ages.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – Uriah Heep
events.description: British hard-rock legends Uriah Heep make their Gießen debut at the Kloster Schiffenberg open-air stage as part of the Kultursommer. A rare chance to see the veteran rock band live in the Mittelhessen hills.

events.title: Weinfest Fulda im Schlosshof
events.description: Fulda's baroque Schlosshof becomes an open-air wine terrace from 26 August to 5 September with over 120 wines from around the world. Live bands every evening, plus Flammkuchen, cheese and sausages (Wed-Sat until midnight).

events.title: Mosburgfest im Schlosspark Biebrich
events.description: The traditional 'Mosburg' open-air party in the Schlosspark of Wiesbaden-Biebrich (28-30 August) offers live bands, drinks and convivial Rheingau atmosphere run by the Gibber Kerbegesellschaft. Weekend highlight with a festive summer mood under the trees of the historic park.

events.title: Kunst- und Theater-Jahrmarkt Papinplatz
events.description: Kassel's Papinplatz hosts a lively Kunst- und Theater-Jahrmarkt with artists, performers, stalls and live acts in the city centre (28-30 August). Art, craft and entertainment mingle in an open-air festival atmosphere.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – Kings of Rap (Kool Savas & Haftbefehl)
events.description: A German hip-hop summit of Kool Savas and Haftbefehl headlines the Gießener Kultursommer at Kloster Schiffenberg in late August. A high-octane evening of rap classics in the open-air amphitheatre.

events.title: Öffentliche Cabinetkellerweinprobe
events.description: An exclusive guided wine-tasting through the historic Cabinetkeller of Kloster Eberbach in Eltville, tracing 1000 years of winemaking history from the monastery vineyards to the Steinbergkeller. Four selected Rheingau wines are poured during the tour.

events.title: Weinfest Fulda – Live-Musikabend
events.description: A special live-music evening at the Weinfest Fulda in the Schlosshof, with party bands and DJs keeping the wine terrace buzzing. One of the highlight nights of the 11-day festival.

events.title: Kultursommer Gießen – MEUTE
events.description: Hamburg's techno-brass ensemble MEUTE closes the Gießener Kultursommer with their unmistakable mix of hypnotic techno and live brass. A dance-flavoured open-air finale at Kloster Schiffenberg.

events.title: RMF – Brasilianische Nacht
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival brings the sound of Brazil into the Basilica of Kloster Eberbach. Violinist Linus Roth leads an evening of Brazilian music in the striking Gothic monastery church near Eltville.

events.title: RMF – Bach: Messe in h-Moll
events.description: Arcangelo under Jonathan Cohen performs Bach's monumental Mass in B minor in the Basilica of Kloster Eberbach. A highlight of this year's Rheingau Musik Festival classical programme, celebrating 80 years of Hesse.

events.title: Darmstädter Weinfest
events.description: Darmstadt's popular wine festival takes over Friedensplatz and the city centre from 3-6 September. Local and regional wineries pour their wines under a canopy of lights, joined by food stalls, live music and a family programme.

events.title: Herbstzauber in der Karlsaue
events.description: The baroque Karlsaue park in Kassel hosts an autumn evening event with illuminated paths, market stalls, live music and culinary specialities (4-6 September). A magical start to the golden season in the city of documents.

events.title: Wetzlarer Brückenfest
events.description: The Wetzlarer Brückenfest (4-6 September) turns the old town's squares — Colchester-Anlage, Eisenmarkt and Schillerplatz — into a festival with live music, stalls and a shopping Sunday. Free-entry city celebration around the historic bridges and half-timbered lanes.

events.title: Riviera Festival Offenbach
events.description: The Riviera Festival for pop and club culture (4-6 September) brings indie, rap, electro, post-punk and pop to the Mainufer in Offenbach. A World Design Capital 2026 event with concerts, readings and late-night dancing.

events.title: ANNOTOPIA Rotenburg a.d. Fulda
events.description: The ANNOTOPIA fantasy festival (4-6 September) turns Rotenburg's Schlosspark on the Fulda into a realm of fantasy, steampunk and magic shows. Costumed performers, artisan market stalls and theatrical entertainment across three days.

events.title: Kasseler Museumsnacht
events.description: Around 50 museums, galleries and cultural institutions across Kassel open their doors late into the night. A shuttle connects venues featuring special exhibits, concerts, performances and hands-on activities for all ages.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest Bensheim
events.description: One of the largest wine festivals on the Hessische Bergstraße (5-13 September) fills Bensheim's old town with around 100,000 visitors, 160 wines in the 'Winzerdorf', food stalls and live music. Grand finale with a festival parade of over 100 floats.

events.title: Langer Herbstmarkt / Kerb
events.description: Langen (near Darmstadt) holds its traditional autumn Kerb in early September with rides, market stalls and live music in the town centre. A lively local folk festival in the Kreis Offenbach town.

events.title: Hofheim – KreisStadtSommer Ausklang & Märkte
events.description: Hofheim am Taunus wraps up its KreisStadtSommer programme with markets, music and culture in the old town and around the Kellereiplatz into September. Local crafts, Taunus food and family-friendly activities.

events.title: Lange Nacht der Museen Fulda
events.description: Under the motto 'Museen unterm Sternenzelt', 16 museums and galleries across Fulda open until midnight on 5 September. Over 50 individual events, illuminated gardens, stargazing walks and live music celebrate culture at night.

events.title: Darmstädter Weinfest – Abschluss-Sonntag
events.description: Final day of the Darmstädter Weinfest with the verkaufsoffener Sonntag (shopping Sunday) in the city centre. Wine stands and music continue in a festive end-of-summer atmosphere.

events.title: Familienfest auf dem Buchhügel
events.description: The Regionalpark RheinMain and the city of Offenbach host this free family festival at the Wetterpark on the Buchhügel on the first Sunday of September. Games, science and fun for children with nature and weather exhibits.
events.location: Wetterpark, Am Wetterpark, 63071 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Beleuchtete Wasserspiele Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
events.description: The UNESCO Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe's famous illuminated water features run on 11-12 September, lighting up the cascades, aqueduct and the 350-metre Great Fountain at night. A spectacular free highlight of the autumn in Kassel.

events.title: Pfungstädter Kerb
events.description: The Pungschter Kerb (11-13 September) is one of southern Hessen's largest folk festivals on the Pfungstadt festival ground. Beer-barrel tapping by the mayor, festival marquee dance nights, a big parade on Saturday and family Sunday.

events.title: Mathildenhöhe – Herbstausstellungen
events.description: Darmstadt's UNESCO World Heritage artists' colony Mathildenhöhe continues its exhibition programme, including the museum and the Hochzeitsturm. Programs and theme exhibitions on Jugendstil and modern art into the autumn season.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest – Festumzug
events.description: The grand festival parade (Festumzug) of the Bergsträßer Winzerfest winds through Bensheim with winery floats, costumes and music. One of the highlights of the region's largest wine celebration.

events.title: Bad Hersfeld – Stiftsruine Kulturnacht
events.description: Following the famous Festspiele, Bad Hersfeld's Stiftsruine hosts a cultural night with concerts in the romantic Romanesque monastery ruin. A special atmospheric venue in the heart of Hersfeld-Rotenburg.

events.title: Hafen 2 Offenbach – Kulturprogramm
events.description: The Hafen 2 in Offenbach (Kulturzentrum & Bistro) runs its autumn programme of concerts, theatre and film nights along the Main. A creative hub venue in the World Design Capital 2026 city.

events.title: Staatstheater Kassel – Saisoneröffnung
events.description: The Staatstheater Kassel opens its 2026/27 season, with the interim venue presenting an 'Aida' preview among opera, theatre and dance productions. A repertory evening at one of Germany's most renowned five-branch theatres.

events.title: Klassikertreffen Rüsselsheim
events.description: The big classic-car meeting (Klassikertreffen) in Rüsselsheim around the Opel Schmiede brings vintage automobiles, live music and family entertainment. A celebration of motoring heritage in the town's old industrial heart.

events.title: Wochenmarkt Marburg – Marktplatz
events.description: Marburg's weekly market on the historic Marktplatz in the Oberstadt runs every Wednesday and Saturday with regional produce and artisanal goods. Breakfast and fresh market atmosphere in the old university town.

events.title: 74. Friedberger Herbstmarkt
events.description: The 74th Friedberger Herbstmarkt runs 18-21 September on the Seewiese in the Wetterau town, around the 3rd Sunday of September. Family fair with rides, food stalls, fireworks, a Tiershow and the traditional Herbstmarktwanderung.

events.title: Winzerfest Groß-Umstadt
events.description: Gross-Umstadt celebrates its traditional Winzerfest on the third weekend of September (18-21 September) on the Marktplatz and in the old town. Wine stands, live music and the ritual opening by the mayor and the wine queens.

events.title: Beats & Barrels Open Air Kassel
events.description: A daytime open-air house-music party in a natural Kassel setting, combining laid-back electronic sets with a relaxed festival feel. For fans of house music and outdoor summer parties.

events.title: Messe Kassel – Messeflohmarkt & Messen
events.description: The Messe Kassel complex hosts recurring public fairs and a large flea market in autumn. A practical family outing for bargain hunters and traders in Nordhessen's exhibition city.

events.title: Wiesbadener Stadtfest, Erntedankfest & Herbstmarkt
events.description: Wiesbaden's big autumn city festival on 25-27 September combines a Herbstmarkt (autumn market) with Erntedankfest celebrations at the Warmen Damm and a shopping Sunday in the city centre. Market stalls, street food, live music on several stages and the motto 'Deine Stadt – Deine Bühne'.

events.title: Eltviller Street Food Festival
events.description: Food trucks and stalls from around the world set up in Eltville's historic centre from 25-27 September, accompanied by a kids area and live atmosphere. Free entry, with street food from all corners of the globe under the half-timbered houses of the Rheingau wine town.

events.title: Weinlese auf Schloss Vollrads
events.description: Experience the grape harvest first-hand at Schloss Vollrads near Oestrich-Winkel. Guests join the picking in the vineyards with an introductory Riesling, followed by a rustic Vesper and a cellar talk by the Kellermeister; each participant receives a bottle of the 2026 Riesling in 2027.

events.title: Licher Wiesnfest Marburg
events.description: The Licher Wiesnfest transforms the Kaufpark Wehrda into Bavaria for two weekends in September, with festival tents, live bands and party atmosphere. The second weekend (25-27 September) features the 'dritte Wiesnhitnacht' and cover acts.

events.title: Burgfestspiele auf der Ronneburg
events.description: The historic Burgfestspiele close the open-air season on Burg Ronneburg over two weekends (26-27 Sept and 3-4 Oct). Knights, minstrels, medieval camps, crafts and theatre bring the ancient hilltop castle in the Wetterau to life.

events.title: Gießener Herbstmesse
events.description: Gießen's traditional autumn fair (Herbstmesse) runs 26 September - 4 October on the Messeplatz an der Ringallee with thrill rides, stalls, fireworks and family fun. Officially opened by the mayor with a big-wheel picnic.

events.title: Eschweger Wurschtfest
events.description: The traditional Wurschtfest in Eschwege is a homage to the butchers' and bakers' craft, held 27 September on the Marktplatz with a big beer garden, stage programme and shopping Sunday. A regional highlight of the Werra-Meißner calendar.

events.title: Bad Nauheimer Kerb
events.description: The Bad Nauheim Kerb on the first October weekend (2-4 October) sets up shooting galleries, bumper cars, carousels and food stalls in the old town. Traditional Kerb with a shopping Sunday in the spa-town centre.

events.title: Wiesbadener Schallplattenbörse
events.description: Over 40 record dealers set up in the Kurhaus-Kolonnaden Wiesbaden offering a huge range of vinyl, CDs and music memorabilia across all genres. A magnet for collectors and music lovers in the Rhein-Main region.

events.title: Fridericianum – Ausstellung 'Hostless'
events.description: The documenta institution Museum Fridericianum presents artist Mohammed Sami in the exhibition 'Hostless' (opening early October). Contemporary art in the historic first public museum on Friedrichsplatz, core of the documenta.

events.title: Hanauer Federweißerfest
events.description: Hanau's Federweißerfest on 3 October at the Parkpromenade celebrates the new wine harvest with Federweißer (young wine), a historic carousel and autumn treats. A convivial seasonal gathering in the Brüder-Grimm city.

events.title: Burgfestspiele Ronneburg – Oktober-Wochenende
events.description: Second weekend of the Burgfestspiele on the Ronneburg (3-4 October) with an autumn medieval festival, jousting-style performances and handicraft market. A final fairy-tale outing in the golden season above the Kinzig valley.

events.title: Puppe & Bär – Spielzeugmarkt
events.description: The long-running 'Puppe & Bär' market in Wiesbaden's Kurhaus brings together dolls, teddy bears, toys, vintage and collectible items. Ideal for families, collectors and vintage enthusiasts.

events.title: Herbstweinwanderung Martinsthal
events.description: A guided autumn wine hike through the glowing vineyards of Martinsthal near Eltville, including a cellar tour of the historic Bergkeller. Breathtaking views over the Rhine valley and wine-tastings straight from the winery Diefenhardt.

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt
events.description: Marburg's big autumn festival on 10-11 October fills the old town with a regional market around the Elisabethkirche, a creative market on the Steinweg and a social/family market. Motto 'Goldener Herbst' brings craft, food and live music to the half-timbered lanes.

events.title: Bad Homburger Erntedankmarkt
events.description: Bad Homburg's Erntedankmarkt on 10-11 October turns the town centre into a rustic autumn market with around 80 stalls of regional produce, handicraft and historical machinery. Fresh apple juice, pumpkins and Federweißer, plus a shopping Sunday on 11 October.
events.location: Innenstadt Bad Homburg, 61348 Bad Homburg v.d. Höhe

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt – Kleinkunst & Familienprogramm
events.description: Second day of the Marburger Elisabethmarkt with busking, stage acts and a family programme in the university town's picture-book old town. Regional produce, handicrafts and autumn specialties.

events.title: Bad Homburg Herbstmarkt
events.description: The autumn market (Herbstmarkt) takes over Bad Homburg's Marktplatz and Kurpark area with regional food, handicraft and autumn specialties on 11 October. A relaxed golden-autumn city walk through the spa town.

events.title: Limburger Oktoberfest
events.description: The 76th Limburger Oktoberfest runs 16-20 October on the Marktplatz (Ste.-Foy-Straße) with music, festival tents and Bavarian-style cheer in the cathedral city. A convivial last big festival before winter.

events.title: Gallusmarkt Wetzlar
events.description: Wetzlar's traditional Gallusmarkt, on record since 1318, takes place annually around St. Gallus' day (16 October). A folk fair with rides, market stalls and autumn festivity on the Haarplatz.

events.title: Lions Club Kleidermarkt Wiesbaden
events.description: The 47th+ charity second-hand clothes market of the Lions Club Wiesbaden-Kochbrunnen is held at the Haus der Vereine in Dotzheim. Proceeds support local charitable projects, with quality pre-owned clothing and accessories for all.
events.location: Haus der Vereine, Im Wiesengrund 14, 65199 Wiesbaden
